feed.title: ClinicOps: verified regulatory changes and corrections
feed.subtitle: Claims from the ClinicOps claims registry that have been read at source and carry a registry id, plus the dated corrections log. Not legal advice.

entry.title: Correction, 14 November 2026
entry.summary: MDCG 2026-4 rev.1 moved Production deployment to December 2026 and the recommended legacy upload date to 27 March 2027; the affected pages were corrected.
entry.content:
MDCG 2026-4 rev.1 moved Production deployment to December 2026 and the recommended legacy upload date to 27 March 2027; the affected pages were corrected.

Source:

  • https://health.ec.europa.eu/document/download/a80332cf-e9f0-4d45-8863-3d96e8c2a675_en?filename=mdcg_2026-4_en.pdf

Registry ids: CO-CLM-0018, CO-CLM-0019. This entry is from the dated corrections log on the Research page.
